# Blue Triangle

bluetriangle.com


* * *

### Company Details

Description


Blue Triangle provides digital teams with a connected view of their marketing, web performance, and third-party tag analytics while constantly monitoring website code for security vulnerabilities. With Blue Triangle, teams can track the experience of every web and mobile app visitor in real time and identify specific web performance, third-party tag, and purchase path issues measurably impacting revenue. This data empowers teams to improve and secure their digital experiences along the most critical areas of the customer journey. Blue Triangle is trusted by Fortune 500 companies including The Home Depot, Marriott, and Carnival Cruise Line, and was named a Gartner ''Cool Vendor''​ in 2017. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Richmond, VA.

### Blue Triangle  's Top Executives

[![Lance Ullom](https://static.equilar.com/prod/79176000/79176917_17628515_largeCircle.png)](https://people.equilar.com/bio/person/lance-ullom-blue-triangle/904032#profile)

[Lance Ullom](https://people.equilar.com/bio/person/lance-ullom-blue-triangle/904032#profile)

Chief Executive Officer

Lance brings deep experience in both technology and venture capital to his role leading Blue Triangle. Earlier in his career he held senior positions at E\*Trade following its acquisition of Telebanc Financial Corporation, one of the first and largest online banks. He has spent 18+ years as an angel investor in the technology sector and is a Principal at Blu Venture Investors, supporting early-stage technology companies in the Mid-Atlantic region. He also serves on the boards of several public and private organizations.


Read More


[![Lance Buchholz](https://static.equilar.com/prod/79176000/79176912_17628510_largeCircle.png)](https://people.equilar.com/bio/person/lance-buchholz-blue-triangle/50362930#profile)

[Lance Buchholz](https://people.equilar.com/bio/person/lance-buchholz-blue-triangle/50362930#profile)

Chief Revenue Officer

Lance has 20+ years of experience helping enterprises solve complex technology challenges, with stints at Wily Technology, CA Technologies, Azul, OPNET, Riverbed, and Aternity. His background spans IT infrastructure, network monitoring, end-user experience management, cloud adoption, and application performance.

Daniel leads the engineering team building the technology behind Blue Triangle's Revenue Assurance platform. His expertise spans scalable data systems, real-time analytics, and cloud-native architectures.

Chuck is a seasoned marketing executive with deep expertise in digital experience optimization. He has led marketing efforts at multiple high-growth technology companies and brings strategic vision to Blue Triangle's brand and demand generation.
